purpose: Pre-declared, semantically judged checkpoints. GREEN is a semantic criterion (right scope, right period, right role, honest unknown), never 'new revenue must be higher/lower' and never a self-generated PASS flag.
grading_rule: Each checkpoint is graded PASS / FAIL / EXTERNAL_LIMIT with the artefact pointer that proves it. A checkpoint is not PASS because a validator exits 0.

checkpoints.question: Does the new input cover exactly the 49 distinct claims of the storage13/process28/analyst28 union, with no silent additions, removals or double counting?
pass_criteria: expected_union_count == 49 and every union claim_id exists exactly once in the new evidence_claims
any removed claim keeps an old->new mapping row so the count cannot be flattered by deletion
role counts reconcile: old 31 mechanism_direction + 18 conversion_assumption
anti_criteria: splitting one claim into two to inflate coverage

checkpoints.question: Does every mechanism claim cite its own business's contiguous segment, on the physical page, inside the native 10-500 character limit?
pass_criteria: Biology activity claims use the H1 p12 biology section (own business), not the page-top TIDES/Testing text
non-TIDES activity claims use the H1 p11 Chemistry operating section that names Chemistry and D&M
TIDES activity claims use the H1 p12 TIDES D&M client/molecule sentence
each excerpt is a contiguous span of the verified page text, and the recorded offsets reproduce it byte-for-byte
anti_criteria: a sentence about another segment offered as own-scope support

checkpoints.question: Is each evidence role the one the excerpt can actually carry?
pass_criteria: a future conditional amount is not labelled reported_fact/actual
a disclosed mechanism sentence is mechanism_direction; a cross-business or cross-period transfer is conversion_assumption
the 18 Chemistry/TIDES price claims keep conversion_assumption (negative control: they were already correct)
no claim asserts a mechanism the excerpt does not contain
anti_criteria: relabelling to make a validator pass
reporting a conditional index as an observed range

checkpoints.question: Are historical actual, point-in-time stock and issuer future expectation separated?
pass_criteria: rpo_expected_2026_opening_cohort is management_guidance with an exact-value claim, explicitly an issuer expected point, not a range and not an actual
FY2025 year-end RPO stock stays a reported point-in-time fact
the expected amount is not added to H1 actual or to new orders, and is not split across sub-businesses
the corrected kind changes no revenue number (the parameter has no revenue-DAG consumer)
anti_criteria: treating the expected point as a full-year floor

checkpoints.question: Can the largest increment be explained by an independent component bridge rather than one shared non-TIDES index?
pass_criteria: six mutually exclusive partitions, TIDES counted once inside Chemistry
non-TIDES decomposed into small-molecule D&M plus a residual that is explicitly not an independent Research-only disclosure
H1 D&M +72.7% and residual ~+5.6% shown as different rhythms
implied H2 D&M growth under a stated residual condition, and the FY2028 multiple, are labelled conditions with their falsifiers
the group net-increment share and the native positive-driver share are reported separately and never mixed
anti_criteria: tuning Base until it meets guidance
turning project/capacity stock into ASP x volume

checkpoints.question: Are CNY 100m -> CNY million conversions, display rounding and conditional stress kept distinct?
pass_criteria: every 亿元/万元 -> CNY million conversion is shown with its arithmetic
issuer display rounding is disclosed per row instead of being silently removed
a displayed interval is never called an empirical confidence or prediction interval
derived amounts inherit and disclose the rounding of their rounded ancestors
anti_criteria: back-solving a high-precision historical number from a rounded disclosure

checkpoints.question: Are genuinely unobservable future quantities kept unknown with their exposure, rather than filled in?
pass_criteria: observed_range stays null where no empirical range exists
the unknown names which conclusion it limits and the CNY million exposure it affects
no invented ASP, utilization, qualified deliveries, cancellation split or cohort schedule
a conditional forecast is allowed to be non-null; null is not manufactured to look cautious
anti_criteria: adding a fake calibration to reach referenced_range
repeated parameter nudging until a reviewer turns green

checkpoints.question: Does each counterexample actually change a condition, a sensitivity or a stated horizon - not just the prose?
pass_criteria: each falsifier names an observable that would change a parameter, a scenario or the justified horizon
at least one falsifier is wired into the native sensitivity or the declared stress input
a falsifier that changes nothing is disclosed as not-yet-operational
anti_criteria: counterevidence that only decorates the narrative

checkpoints.question: Is the formal main/stress chain executed through the real native CLI with frozen consumed bytes?
pass_criteria: main and stress each run real validate -> compute/render -> snapshot create
each call is frozen by execution_request build + audit capture, and the consumed input SHA equals the built request SHA
output/snapshot input_sha256 equals the actually consumed input SHA
every failed attempt is retained

checkpoints.question: Do the method references generalise beyond this company?
pass_criteria: no company name, segment Chinese label or D&M-specific token becomes a code or method rule
a different business structure (subscription platform + services) is exercised offline as a positive and a negative example
no new approval gate, no fourth methodology, no second calculation engine
anti_criteria: a company-specific special case in product code
turning this bridge into a universal template

predeclared_expectations_that_must_NOT_b: New Base revenue must be higher than the old Base
New Base must land inside the raised management guidance range
The preparation package's own PASS flags are true
All claims must end up with a mechanism role
